datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2020, classifying geographic areas of Mali by food insecurity phase. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions aggregated at administrative or livelihood zones and stored as geospatial features with classification metadata.

sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity and geographic extent.
